d: Martin and Selena talk about the new documentary on Netflix “SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of,” Martin accidentally cutting into Selena’s wedding cake, Canadian Thanksgiving, Barack Obama giving Martin a shout out, Selena hosting a group of her fans for Friendsgiving dinner and taking them to see the Jonas Brothers at the Hollywood Bowl, season six of “Only Murders in the Building” on Hulu, filming in London, the impressive British actors they worked with, Steve Martin bringing his banjo to England, acting with the incredible Meryl Streep, and how Selena feels about working…
